infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NXCO needs your location to mark attendance and share your live position with Admin while you're checked in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NXCO needs your location to keep sharing your live position with Admin while you're checked in, even if the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NXCO needs camera access so you can take a photo of a shop or attach a photo to an order.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NXCO needs photo library access so you can choose a shop photo or attach a document image to an order.
